words.gloss: he who is in the heart

literal: Sleeping time, shoulder-upon-he having become; waking time, heart-in-he he becomes, swiftly.
translation: When I sleep, he rests upon my shoulders; when I wake, he swiftly moves into my heart.
modern: நான் தூங்கும்போது என் தோள் மேல் இருப்பவர், நான் விழிக்கும்போது விரைந்து என் நெஞ்சத்திற்குள் சென்று விடுகிறார்.
explanation: The speaker describes the constant presence of her lover, whether she is asleep or awake. During her sleep, he appears in her dreams and embraces her shoulders. The moment she wakes up, he vanishes from her side but instantly takes residence in her heart as a memory. The words 'துஞ்சும் கால்' (when sleeping) and 'விழிக்கும் கால்' (when waking) contrast her two states, showing that her lover never truly leaves her.
